authoring_links.notes: provider/provider_label does not select an adapter. The URL is produced by the explicit edit_url_template and shared path mapping/encoding.

communication.notes: Communication URLs use the generic template formatter and configured host allowlists; no GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket issue or discussion API client is included.

keycloak_asciidoc.scope: Keycloak AsciiDoc xref/link rewriting for the configured edit target.

artifact.scope: Build artifact handoff to the configured workflow; not a remote hosting API client.

command.scope: Explicit operator-supplied argv with allowlisted environment; no implicit shell or built-in provider API.

filesystem.scope: Validated local filesystem copy with atomic replacement options.

git.notes: Other VCS providers and source materialization modes are not implemented.

github_actions.notes: The generated workflow uses GitHub Actions and the GitHub Pages artifact/deploy actions. It does not publish directly through a GitHub API adapter.
